payload.defect: DoD-P15-1 tree-hygiene gate has no fallback when task_zone is unresolvable, so it degrades to a REPO-WIDE destructive revert.
payload.mechanism: task_zone = signal.payload.zone ?? infer_from_task_id(original_task_id). For an orphan whose task_id carries no code zone (observed live: task:po-triage-20260824, payload={site:S3,spawning:po}, no zone field), task_zone resolves empty. The gate then runs `git status --porcelain -- <empty>` (= whole repo) and `git checkout -- <file>` on every ^[ M]M line.

payload.why_premise_false_here: The gate premise is `a dead worker uncommitted edits are LIVE in the shared working tree`. None of the 4 dirty files belonged to the dead session 7fd9c60a — they are live peer/current-tick writes. The dead session own triage output had already been recovered and committed by ce35319c5.
payload.action_taken_this_tick: Gate SKIPPED deliberately; no revert run; no file touched. Adoption claim taken then released after the Phase B intent:po:triage collision blocked the spawn.
payload.proposed_fix: Make the gate fail-closed on an unresolvable zone: if task_zone is null/empty -> do NOT run git status/checkout at all; log + escalate instead. Never allow an empty pathspec to widen the revert scope. Optionally also restrict the revert to files whose last-writer can be attributed to the dead session.
